figurative_meaning_en: A part of the Bengali wedding ceremony
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের পর বউভাতের অনুষ্ঠানে সকলে উপভোগ করে।
বউভাতে নতুন বউ প্রথমবার স্বামীর পরিবারের সঙ্গে ভাত খায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone enjoys the bou bhat ceremony after the wedding.
In bou bhat, the new bride eats rice for the first time with her husband's family.
note: Refers to the ritual where the bride first partakes in a meal with her in-laws after marriage, symbolizing integration into the family.
